subject: Re: Kickoff: DualDICE for off-policy evaluation
body:
Validation status, two weeks in.

Tabular GridWalk: estimates match the oracle within 1% across the policy pairs we tested — remembering the release's caveat that the printed target rewards are themselves estimates, so we bumped num_trajectories to 1000 for a fair oracle.

Non-tabular is where the practical lessons live. Joint optimization of nu and zeta is unstable exactly as documented; the nu/zeta learning-rate pair dominates everything else (we landed on 0.0001/0.001, same as the reference), and lower gamma makes optimization noticeably easier. For the toolkit defaults I'm encoding: start from the reference learning rates, expose gamma prominently, and surface a divergence warning when the nu loss oscillates.

Risk for the pilot: our logged partner data has much longer horizons than GridWalk; at gamma close to 1 the correction estimates get high-variance. Farah and I are adding a variance-based confidence caveat to every estimate the module emits — better to say "low confidence" than be quietly wrong.

Halima
